crop_note: Sheet on black backdrop; visible vertical centre fold (album mounting); corners slightly rounded/worn.
evidence: Blue sky with a single cloud band, sunny sea with sailing boats; orange horizon read as bokashi convention, not sunset. Time of day is a guess (travellers walking the embankment street, no lanterns). No plants or clothing pin the season.
taxonomy_friction: Season null because nothing in the image indicates it; schema can't distinguish 'no cue / any season' from 'unknown'. Orange horizon band + dark top band are conventions that also read as dusk to a naive tagger.

crop_note: Sheet with narrow margin on light backdrop; small notch/corner cuts.
evidence: Title 'hakuu' (sudden shower); dense slanted rain lines, bamboo grove bent by wind, travellers running with straw capes. Hakuu is a summer shower term; grey light makes time of day a guess (daytime assumed).
taxonomy_friction: Sudden summer downpour (yūdachi/hakuu) is a distinct, very seasonal phenomenon; rain+storm mix loses the 'brief shower' sense. Bamboo grove counted as forest.

crop_note: Sheet fills nearly the whole frame; no visible backdrop.
evidence: White plum blossoms on bare trees, tea houses and strollers (title 'Plum Park', published 2nd month). Pink-to-dark sky is a bokashi gradient; read as daytime with some dawn/dusk share as a guess.
taxonomy_friction: Pink/red sky with dark top band: convention or glow? Unclear, so split. Marker names have no canonical IDs in TAXONOMY (used snake_case 'plum_blossom'). Small stream/pond at left: river vs lake ambiguous.

crop_note: Sheet on light grey backdrop; faint vertical fold at centre.
evidence: Pale even sky, blue haze band behind Fuji (partly convention, a little haze counted), farmers on terraced fields and thatched houses; daylight scene. No seasonal plants; green fields could be any growing season.
taxonomy_friction: Blue band at horizon: sea, haze or convention? Counted as slight mist, not water. Season: green fields hint at spring-autumn but too weak to commit, so null.

crop_note: Full sheet with wide paper margins, pencilled English title and signature below image; dealer/museum label pasted overlapping the lower right corner; deckled top edge.
evidence: Weeping cherry in full bloom propped on poles, red temple gate, women and children viewing; soft pinkish-grey sky read as spring haze/overcast. Daylight from even lighting (no lanterns).
taxonomy_friction: Weeping cherry (shidarezakura) blooms a little earlier than somei-yoshino; single cherry marker can't express that. Shin hanga soft hazy sky sits between clear, cloudy and mist.

place.name: Takuhi Shrine (Takibi no yashiro), Nishinoshima, Oki Islands

crop_note: Image trimmed to (or near) sheet edge; no backdrop visible.
evidence: Ship's bow in rolling waves below a dark wooded island; no sky shown, so weather null. Overall dark teal palette plus the bonfire-shrine legend (guiding fires seen from ships at night) suggest night; still largely a guess.
taxonomy_friction: No sky at all, but rough whitecapped sea gives wind/roughness; schema has no 'sea state'. Shrine named in title is not actually visible, so temple_shrine flag left off; place is the shrine but the viewpoint is offshore. Publication month (12th) is not scene season.

crop_note: Sheet edge close to frame; rounded corner cut-outs typical of series.
evidence: Title 'Rain on the Plain'; dark sky band, leaves stripped and flying, trees bent, travellers and pack horses leaning into the wind. Rain lines barely visible, so storm/rain inferred mostly from wind and title. Pink horizon makes dusk possible; time is a guess. Falling leaves suggest autumn.
taxonomy_friction: Wind-dominated storm without drawn rain lines: 'storm' requires rain or waves, and wind is only a modifier, so a gale scene is hard to express. Grey water band at left could be flooded paddies or a river.

place.name: Hyapponkui, Sumida River near Ryōgoku, Tokyo

crop_note: Sheet fills the frame (small postcard-size print, 11 x 17 cm); title cartouche in lower margin; paper slightly soiled.
evidence: Title 'Crescent Moon'; crescent moon among scattered clouds, lights on the far bank, rickshaw on the riverside road, monochrome dark palette. No seasonal plants (bare stakes/willow shoots only).
taxonomy_friction: Moon is a yes/no modifier, but a crescent is visible in conditions different from full-moon prints (and phase matters for 'currently visible'). Meiji-era scene (rickshaw) - no era field.

crop_note: Full sheet with margins on black backdrop; publisher's marks in lower margin.
evidence: Japanese Chin on a red cushion indoors with a caged white-eye; no sky, plants or setting, so every scored dimension is null.
taxonomy_friction: Kachō-e by museum genre but really an indoor pet portrait; brief says include bird-and-flower, yet it carries zero matchable signal and would score neutral everywhere. Suggest an exclusion or low-priority rule for interior animal prints. Genre list has no 'animal' value.

crop_note: Scan includes cream window mount around the sheet; inventory number pencilled on mount below; printed chained-lozenge frame inside the sheet.
evidence: Title 'cherry trees in leaf' (hazakura) along the Sumida; trees with leaves and last blossoms, walkers and a tea seller on the bank, sailboats. Pinkish clouds near horizon could be glow or convention; time split as a guess.
taxonomy_friction: New marker 'hazakura' (cherry trees in fresh leaf, ~late April-mid May) needed; neither cherry blossom nor a summer marker fits. Cherry embankment counted as garden_park (blossom-viewing place) though it is not a park.

crop_note: Sheet fills frame with rounded corner cut-outs; collector's marks are on/under the sheet edge (not visible in scan).
evidence: Orange-red horizon glow with a line of wild geese descending over sailing boats; travellers on the pine-clad cliff hold their hats. Descending geese + evening glow (also in museum notes) drive dusk and autumn.
taxonomy_friction: Museum notes say Suruga Bay, but Kokufu-dai (Kōnodai) overlooks the Edo/Tone River - metadata can mislead. Broad estuary between river and sea. Marker IDs not canonical ('wild_geese').

exclude_reason: Warrior print (Tomoe Gozen on horseback, kabuki scene) from a poem series; figure dominates, no setting.
crop_note: Sheet on grey backdrop; horizontal crease at left middle; worn edges.
evidence: Large white flakes against a dark grey ground, poem by Emperor Kōkō mentions snow; dark ground is a device to show snow, so time left null.
taxonomy_friction: Dark background behind falling snow could be read as night; ambiguous convention not covered in the notes.

exclude_reason: Table-of-contents sheet for One Hundred Famous Views of Edo: text cartouches, decorative plum/cuckoo/moon background, no scene.
crop_note: Colour checker (Digital ColorChecker SG) beside the sheet on the right; light backdrop.
evidence: Text cartouches over a decorative dark ground with plum blossoms and a cuckoo before a full moon; motifs are emblematic (mixing spring and summer), not a scene.
taxonomy_friction: Moon present only as a decorative motif; marked true but meaningless for matching. Colour-checker targets in scans need a crop rule.

exclude_reason: Book (Hokusai manga vol. 6); scan shows only the closed blue cover.
crop_note: Closed bound book on black backdrop; stitched spine on right, title slip at left, collection label at top.
evidence: Image is the patterned cover of a bound book; no picture content visible.
taxonomy_friction: Nothing (clear exclusion), but the sample source lets non-prints through the 'random_landscape' group.

exclude_reason: Surimono still life (writing brushes, writing set, knife, scissors) with poem; no scene.
crop_note: Nearly square surimono sheet on light backdrop.
evidence: Still life of writing utensils and goods from Arima on folded paper with a poem; no setting or sky.
taxonomy_friction: Surimono often carry New Year meaning (implicit seasonal marker) that the schema could record even when excluded; left empty here.

crop_note: Sheet fills frame; thin margin around keyblock border.
evidence: Thick snow on roofs, trees, bridge and banks under a dark grey sky; no flakes in the air, so snow cover with overcast sky. Dark sky leaves dusk possible; time mostly a guess (travellers crossing).
taxonomy_friction: snow_cover lives in the weather vector, so 'snow on the ground + overcast' has to be split between two categories; a separate snow-cover modifier would be cleaner. Distant white mountain not identifiable as Fuji.

place.name: Edo Bay off Kazusa coast (Kisarazu area)

crop_note: Sheet fills frame; slight trimming at edges.
evidence: Pale clear sky with dark top bokashi (convention), filled sails and light ripples; daylight. No seasonal cues.
taxonomy_friction: Open-sea viewpoint: settlement 'wild' and terrain 'flat' are technically right but awkward; a 'water-only/offshore' scene type would match better. Place is a vague sea area, hence 15 km precision.

exclude_reason: Erotic (shunga) interior figure print; landscape only seen through window.
crop_note: Sheet fills frame; text cartouche in cloud shape at top.
evidence: Title 'evening bell at Ueno' (Eight Views parody) gives dusk; lotus pads on the pond outside the window give summer.
taxonomy_friction: Lotus (hasu, peak ~late July) is a common summer marker missing from the list; added 'lotus'. Eight-Views titles are useful time cues even in excluded prints.

place.name: Ōumayagashi ferry, Sumida River near Kuramae, Tokyo

crop_note: Sheet fills frame with margin; censor/date seals top right outside image border.
evidence: Dark sky gradient, silhouetted far bank, hooded night-walkers (yotaka) at the ferry landing and ferry boat crossing; overall dark palette indicates night. Leafy willow suggests summer.
taxonomy_friction: Grey-blue sky without moon or lanterns: cloudy vs. night convention hard to separate. No seasonal marker for leafy willow (shidare-yanagi, summer).

crop_note: Sheet fills frame; thin light margin.
evidence: Title 'shower below the summit'; lightning bolts in the dark lower slope while the summit stands in blue sky with cumulus. Snow mostly melted and thunderheads suggest summer; daytime light.
taxonomy_friction: Two weather states at once (storm below, clear above) - a mixed vector is a poor stand-in for a split scene. No real viewpoint for 'place' (the mountain itself), so place set to Fuji with coarse precision.
